value.rationale: The result identifies a natural exact extremal invariant for a classical decidable prefix class: the largest possible endpoint of a finite graph spectrum at fixed quantifier-block lengths. It replaces a coarse exponential Ramsey estimate by the precise diagonal Ramsey number and proves that no further universal improvement is possible; this is a meaningful finite cutoff rather than a parameter renaming.
